architectural-decision-records.why: records the first-traveling-gate decision, the 1.2.0 version lead, and the scan-scope finding
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0060: reference-links travels via invoke+marker; manifest bumped to unreleased 1.2.0 so origin-mode provenance holds; documented why the code-scan gates are deferred (whole-repo scan false-positives on gate infra)
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the new traveling gate is proven to run+detect in a consumer
verifiable-quality-gates.what: extended the consumer-green test to also run the copied reference-links test in a bootstrapped consumer, so a reference-links that cannot resolve or detect in a consumer fails
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds a manifest gate, so its consumer-run coverage is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: the genesis-into-consumer integration test now exercises reference-links end to end; the right level for a traveling gate
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the manifest + test change; behavior pinned as a scenario
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements reference-links traveling to a consumer with a consumer-green scenario
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the limits rather than overclaiming the travel story
skeptical-audit.what: documented that reference-links is a modest first gate, that the code-scan gates false-positive on gate infra (so deferred), and that consumers pin unreleased 1.2.0 until it ships
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran a fresh-context judge-arch over the manifest change, the marker, the consumer-green test, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no security surface changed; the owasp-lints change was reverted and deferred to the scan-scope PR

release-deployment-safety.why: the manifest version leads at 1.2.0 (unreleased); the package release is a later PR, not this diff

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a manifest entry + marker; no system/data architecture change

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or migration

arch-encode.why: a manifest addition, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake

universal-browser-device-support.why: no browser UI; the no-ua-sniffing change was reverted
